feeds.title: Women Entrepreneurs Finance Initiative
feeds.description: The Women Entrepreneurs Finance Initiative supports women entrepreneurs by scaling up access to financial products and services, building capacity, expanding networks, offering mentors, and providing opportunities to link with domestic and global markets. Its holistic approach helps women in developing countries gain increased access to the finance, markets, and networks necessary to start and grow a business.

feeds.title: Classy Career Girl Blog
feeds.description: Classy Career Girl is now one of Forbes's 35 Most Influential Career Sites and a leading destination for ambitious women, currently reaching millions of women each week. They are passionate about helping women who want to make a difference in the world. They are providing an e-learning platform designed to be a one-stop-shop for all women in career transition. Visit their blog and learn more about articles, videos, podcasts, membership, and more.

feeds.title: Alberta Women Entrepreneurs Blog
feeds.description: Publicly supported and funded since its launch in 1995, AWE is a not-for-profit organization providing tools and resources to help women across Alberta build successful businesses.AWE provides unique programs and services to women at all stages of business through advising, financing, mentoring, and skills and network development.

feeds.title: Women Entrepreneurs GROW Global Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to educate, inspire and nurture women business owners and entrepreneurs worldwide on how to go global so they can run healthier businesses and create a new future for themselves, their families, and their community. Our vision is a world where every woman business owner has the opportunity and ability to take their business global wherever they may be located.

feeds.title: AWEC Blog
feeds.description: AWEC was founded in the summer of 2017 as a direct result of feedback from hundreds of African entrepreneurs who took part in pilot online courses that formed the foundation of our innovative blended learning model. Traditional, short-term, and place-based accelerators that tended to favor male entrepreneurs were not serving the needs of the millions of women entrepreneurs across Africa.

feeds.title: Jaishree Nenwani Blog
feeds.description: Jaishree Nenwani is an Author-Blogger -Homepreneur. Jaishree's content revolves around Inspired Wisdom, Self-improvement, Personal growth and ways to become happier in your life. She is passionate about journaling and love to share wisdom and journaling tools that invoke deeper authenticity and Personal transformation.

feeds.title: The Female CEO Blog
feeds.description: We are a passionate community of Female-Led business owners navigating the world of entrepreneurship together. Building a business can feel like a challenge, and that's why we created this platform, community, magazine, and membership, so that no matter where you are, you are never alone. With an incredible team of expert voices across seven countries, each with a specialist area of expertise, we've got you covered from startup to CEO.

feeds.title: Lioness Magazine
feeds.description: Lioness For The Female Entrepreneur gives women the latest news, tools, and resources to launch and scale startups. We encourage women to Unleash the Lioness Within! Get breaking news and insights on women-founded startups and the latest trends.

feeds.title: She Owns It Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to She Owns it! My name is Melissa Stewart. I'm a coffee-drinking, side hustle-juggling, entrepreneur-enabling, purveyor of possibility. Behind every successful woman is her story and that's what She Owns It is all about. Empowering women to write their own success stories.

feeds.title: She Takes on the World Blog
feeds.description: The business and lifestyle blog for women entrepreneurs.Natalie is an Emmy Award-winning media entrepreneur, creator of soulseconds.com, and mentor to women entrepreneurs at shetakesontheworld.com.

feeds.title: Female Entrepreneur Association Blog
feeds.description: An international hub for female entrepreneurs to get inspired and empowered to turn their ideas into a reality and build successful businesses. We publish inspiring stories about female entrepreneurs from around the world.

feeds.title: LH Agenda
feeds.description: An online community created to nurture, inspire and empower female leaders. We create elegant, inspirational and purposeful stationery that helps women shape daily habits to nurture and empower the leader inside them.

feeds.title: The Unconventional Business Woman Blog
feeds.description: The Unconventional Business Woman aka Real Work From Home Jobs and Business Opportunities is a book, blog, and podcast about creative home-based work and business ideas by Career Coach and speaker Darlene Oliver. Providing a community forum for real work-from-home jobs and business opportunities blog.

feeds.title: Entrepreneur India » Women Entrepreneur
feeds.description: Get the latest news, videos, and discussion topics on Women entrepreneurs. For 38 years, Entrepreneur has been the definitive guide to all the diverse challenges of business ownership. The magazine has quickly expanded along with the needs of its readers, equipping entrepreneurs with the critical information they require and demand to grow their businesses.
